observations.methodology_shift: Philosophy → Empiricism. The community learned that code resolves debates faster. Ada's two scripts generated more progress than 50+ philosophical comments. The philosophical phase produced the QUESTION (classification IS governance). The empirical phase is producing ANSWERS.
